method: Read-only per-frame native trace of the recorded winning route (evidence/local/native-trace-winning-route-ram-20261109.jsonl) plus a native-only RAM probe of the loop frames (tools/fidelity-lab/area-probe.mjs; evidence/area-transitions-findings-20261109.md). No ROM inspection. Native x is absolute inside the level: each pipe room starts on its own page (entry x 56 on page 7/12/0/16 reads 1848/3128/56/4152) and a wrong corridor subtracts exactly 1024 (four pages) from Mario and the camera. The remake keeps the repeated stream as one longer area, so native x is compared 'unrolled' (+1024 per wrap).

loop.note: The player page byte and the camera page byte both drop by 4 and the enemy slots are cleared on the wrap frame; Mario's sub-page x and the camera's x continue unchanged (x -= 1024 plus that frame's movement).

area-3.evidence: The previous layout candidate repeated the corridor every 992 px (camera-registration alias of 80 px, see evidence/eight-four-loop-ambiguity.md). The native wraps are exactly 1024, so two plain floor columns pad the corridor to 1024 and the repeat distance becomes 1024: the third-pass pipe then sits at 576+2048, where the native entry is at x 2630+... (3654-3072+2048).

area-4.evidence: Native Mario starts the pipe animation at x 1076 and is stopped at x 1088 (engine 2, rows 78989-79040) with the pipe wall 16 px further, at 1104; he lands on the pipe ledge (feet 144) at x 1072. The compiled map has the mouth at 1136 and the wall at 1152, i.e. three columns (48 px) of camera-registration alias before the final ledge. The three columns 67-69 are removed and everything from column 70 moves left by 48 px.

main.evidence: Native lap 1 passes x 1072-1151 on the floor and x 1125-1175 in one jump where the compiled map has a block and a pipe; its sprite never lands on a pipe top at 112 near x 1264-1295 but falls from the y=96 ledge (x 1282) onto a pipe top at feet 128 at unrolled x 1301 (page 0 x 277 after the first wrap) and enters it with Down. The compiled map's pipe at x 1136 and tall pipe at x 1264 are not solid natively; the native exit pipe is added at unrolled x 1296-1327 and the area is extended to hold it.

ledge.note: native Mario stands at feet 96 for x 1207-1281 (unrolled)

nativeMap.evidence: Native collision map RAM 0x500-0x69f replayed along the recorded route from 8-4 frame 75000 (tools/fidelity-lab/area-probe.mjs, 1,200 rows, every on-screen column read on every row, no column changed value; remake row = native row + 2). Columns 66-74 are empty from the ceiling down to the bottom row: a pit crossed on the id 40 lift (x 1067..1120, y 208, slot 1 from row 633) on which the route stands at native y 176 (x 1123, row 812); the earlier 'floor at x 1072-1151' was that lift. Columns 59-63 are floor (no lava), 79-80 are solid from y 160 like 75-78, the y 96 ledge is columns 76-79 only, there is no pipe at columns 39-40 and column 22 has the ceiling.

continuation.evidence: Native collision map RAM 0x500-0x69f (row 0 = y 32) read on every on-screen column while replaying explore-r4 8-4/mood5 from the 8-4 checkpoint (2,560 rows, wraps at rows 616 and 1546) and the recorded route (1,100 rows, one wrap); both runs give the same map for columns 0-89. Unrolled columns 96-191 repeat columns 32-95 cell for cell, so after column 95 the stream is columns 32-95 again (period 1024; the wrap itself subtracts 1024 when Mario reaches x 1281). Enemy objects repeat with the same +1024: Piranhas 824/1304/1448 -> 1848/2328/2472 -> 2872, Goombas 900/923/947 -> 1921/1945/1969 -> 2944/2967/2992, lift id 40 1120 -> 2144. Columns 83-89 and 92-95 are solid from y 160, a non-enterable pipe at columns 90-91 has its top at y 112 (native 0x12/0x13 top, 0x14/0x15 body).
